item.title: Lawes tops Reese-Hansen on opening night at Scotties Tournament of Hearts
item.description: MISSISSAUGA — Youth was no match for experience on Friday night at the Scotties Tournament of Hearts.

item.title: 'Significant' damage to B.C. island community's only bridge scraps reopening schedule
item.description: DELTA — A bridge that provides the only road access to a Metro Vancouver island community has suffered more significant damage than originally thought after the span was hit by a tugboat, and a precautionary boil-water advisory has also been issued.

item.title: 'Odd and weird': Marner reflects on first game in Toronto since leaving Maple Leafs
item.description: TORONTO — Mitch Marner stepped on the ice for warm-ups and heard some boos during an initial lap around a rink he knows well. The Vegas Golden Knights winger experienced more jeers on his first shift.

item.title: Hendrix Lapierre ends 90-game scoring drought in Capitals' 3-1 win over Flames
item.description: CALGARY — Hendrix Lapierre ended a run of 90 NHL games without a goal by scoring for the Washington Capitals in a 3-1 win over the Calgary Flames on Friday.

item.title: Combining exercise with volunteering works out for members of a UK alternative to gyms
item.description: LONDON (AP) — Shoveling piles of compost and clearing weeds on a cold, damp evening in London might not be most people’s idea of fun.

item.title: James' shootout goal lifts Lightning over Blackhawks
item.description: CHICAGO (AP) — Dominic James scored in the fifth round of a shootout and the Tampa Bay Lightning made it 15 straight games without a regulation loss, outlasting the Chicago Blackhawks 2-1 on Friday night.

item.title: Glass scores twice as New Jersey Devils capture 5-4 victory over Vancouver Canucks
item.description: VANCOUVER — The New Jersey Devils extended their Western Canada winning streak to three games with a 5-4 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Friday at Rogers Arena.

item.title: Mamukelashvili's 22 points lead Raptors past Blazers, snapping Portland's win streak
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (AP) — Sandro Mamukelashvili scored 22 points and Brandon Ingram added 20 to help the Toronto Raptors beat the Portland Trail Blazers 110-98 on Friday night.

item.title: Channing Tatum, Olivia Wilde and Charli XCX premiere movies at Sundance Film Festival
item.description: PARK CITY, Utah (AP) — The Sundance Film Festival was in full swing Friday in Park City, with Channing Tatum , Olivia Wilde and Charli XCX movies premiering back-to-back at the storied Eccles Theatre in the evening.
